rules.statement: A diga married husband can inherit from his wife, even if she has subsequently acquired binna rights.
rules.supporting_quote: "The only consequence of a diga married daughter preserving or subsequently acquiring binna rights is that the forfeiture of the rights of paternal inheritance does not take place, but she inherits as though she was married in binna. The husband does not cease to be a diga married husband and begin to be a binna married husband."
